title: 第11章 厚土诀第12章 神秘小鼎
lines: 登记完信息，冯大富带著王扶去仓库领了被褥和两套制式的麻布衣裳，这是落羽宗杂役弟子的专属服装。
“虽说小冬峰上的都是杂役弟子，不过王师弟应该也知道，杂役弟子也能修行，只要在十年之內修炼到链气四重，就能摆脱杂役弟子的身份，成为正式弟子。”
冯大富领著王扶继续在院子里走，来到院子的正门大殿。
“冯师兄，应该是正式弟子吧。”
王扶本想著恭维一下，见这个胖子笑眯眯的点头这才知道对方地位本就比自己高，也是，小冬峰主事总归不是一般弟子能担当的。
冯大富掀开桌案上的布帛，露出三本小册子：“这是三本基础修炼法诀，本来有五本的，前段时间来了两个新人，就剩这三本了，王师弟你看看想选哪个。”
“有劳师兄了。”
王扶一脸喜色地看过去，这可是凡人梦寐以求的修仙法诀啊。
只见三本小册子，分別写著【水元功】【纵火决】【厚土诀】。
见王扶愣神，冯大富有些好笑，作为过来人他也知道什么心情，想到这小子和赵泽霖有关係，也想打好关係，其他人他都是直接隨便扔一本过去，哪来这么多时间还任由挑选，反正都是五行杂灵根。
“王师弟不妨看看三本法诀的介绍再做决定，各有千秋。”
王扶点点头，不过他却没去拿法诀，反而看著冯大富，挠了挠头:“冯师兄这不是为难我么，我哪看得懂啊。”
“冯师兄你见识渊博，不如替师弟选择一下？”
“还是你自己选吧。”
冯大富可不想今后被赵泽霖找麻烦，“不过我可以给你介绍一下。”
“【水元功】重在灵力绵长，附带水箭术和水镜术两种法术。”
“【纵火决】重在爆发力，附带火球术和控火术两种法术。”
“至於【厚土诀】嘛，相比另外两部法诀更容易修炼一点，毕竟咱们身在大山深处，踩著大地修行，更容易感受到土灵气。
同样附带两种法术，土刺术和遁地术。”
冯大富想到这【厚土诀】的法术不由咂咂嘴。
“修炼更快一点？”
王扶眨了眨眼睛，他虽然初入修仙界，但也知道修炼越快才能走得越远，不然为啥他这个五行杂灵根只能沦为杂役弟子，而周鹏他们却能直接成为正式弟子。
灵根，灵根，说白了，不就是修炼速度的差距么。
冯大富见王扶的表情，见怪不怪，“王师弟可是想选这【厚土诀】？”
王扶正要点头，却被冯大富打断。
“先別急著做选择，听我说完。
【厚土诀】的修炼速度的確快一点，但很有限，肯定比不得灵根上的差距。
而且【厚土诀】附带的两种法术中的遁地术极其深奥，极难领悟，我来落羽宗这么多年也没听说有谁修炼成功过，所以嘛就意味著选择【厚土诀】的人比其他人要少一道法术。”
content_en:
After registering the information, Feng Dafu took Wang Fu to the warehouse to get a bedding and two sets of standard linen clothes, which were exclusive clothes for the Luoyu Sect's handyman disciples.
"Although the people on Xiaodong Peak are all handyman disciples, Junior Brother Wang should also know that handyman disciples can also practice. As long as they reach the fourth level of chain energy within ten years, they can get rid of their status as handyman disciples and become official disciples."
Feng Dafu led Wang Fu to continue walking in the courtyard and came to the main entrance hall of the courtyard.
"Senior Brother Feng, he should be an official disciple."
Wang Fu originally thought about complimenting him, but when he saw the fat man nodding with a smile, he realized that the other person's status was higher than his own. Also, the responsibility of being in charge of Xiaodong Peak was not something that ordinary disciples could take on.
Feng Dafu opened the cloth on the desk and revealed three booklets: "These are three basic cultivation techniques. There were originally five. Two newcomers came here some time ago, and these are the only three left. Junior Brother Wang, take a look at which one you want to choose."
"Thank you, senior brother."
Wang Fu looked over with joy on his face, this was the magic formula for cultivating immortality that mortals only dreamed of.
I saw only three booklets, which read "Shui Yuan Gong", "Arson Technique" and "Thick Earth Technique" respectively.
Seeing Wang Fu's stunned expression, Feng Dafu was a little amused. As someone who had been there, he knew how he was feeling. Thinking that this kid had a relationship with Zhao Zelin, he also wanted to have a good relationship. He just threw a copy of the others at random. How could he have so much time to choose at will? They are all five elements and spiritual roots.
"Junior brother Wang might as well read the introductions of the three books before making a decision. Each has its own merits."
Wang Fu nodded, but he did not go to get the magic formula. Instead, he looked at Feng Dafu and scratched his head: "Senior Brother Feng, isn't this making things difficult for me? How can I understand?"
"Senior Brother Feng, you are knowledgeable, why don't you make a choice for me?"
"It's up to you to choose."
Feng Dafu didn't want to be troubled by Zhao Zelin in the future, "But I can introduce it to you."
"[Water Yuan Gong] focuses on long-lasting spiritual power, and comes with two spells: water arrow and water mirror."
"[Arson] focuses on explosive power, and comes with two spells: fireball and fire control."
"As for the [Thick Earth Technique], it is easier to practice than the other two techniques. After all, we are deep in the mountains, practicing on the earth, and it is easier to feel the spiritual energy of the earth.
It also comes with two spells, earth stabbing and earth escape. "
Feng Dafu couldn't help but smack his lips when he thought of this [Thick Earth Technique] spell.
"Practice faster?"
Wang Fu blinked. Although he had just entered the world of immortality, he also knew that the faster he cultivated, the farther he could go. Otherwise, why would he, a miscellaneous spirit of the Five Elements, be reduced to a handyman disciple, while Zhou Peng and the others could directly become formal disciples.
Spiritual roots, spiritual roots, to put it bluntly, isn't it just the difference in cultivation speed.
"Hehe..."
Seeing Wang Fu's expression, Feng Dafu was not surprised, "Junior Brother Wang, do you want to choose this [Thick Earth Technique]?"
Wang Fuzheng was about to nod, but was interrupted by Feng Dafu.
"Don't make a choice in a hurry, just listen to what I have to say.
The training speed of [Thick Earth Technique] is indeed faster, but it is very limited and cannot be compared with the difference in spiritual roots.
Moreover, the Earth Escape Technique among the two spells attached to [Thick Earth Technique] is extremely profound and difficult to understand. I have been in Luo Yu Sect for so many years and I have never heard of anyone successfully practicing it, so it means that people who choose [Thick Earth Technique] have one less spell than others. "
